 Oral Judgment

(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE N.S.SANJAY GOWDA)
1.
The insurer is in appeal challenging the award of Rs.7,83,000/- granted for the death of Mounesh.
2. The insurer in his appeal basically contending that it had not insured the offending vehicle and hence the liability could not be fastened on it.

It is also contended that the claimants did not produce the details of Insurance policy and therefore it could not be assumed that the NC:
2024:KHC-K:6899 appellant had insured the vehicle, especially when it had taken the specific stand that it had not issued an insurance policy.
3.
A perusal of the impugned order indicates that the Tribunal has not even considered the plea of the Insurance Company regarding its assertion that it had not insured the offending vehicle.

It is obvious that the contention raised by the insurer has not even been noticed.

4. In that view of the matter, in my view, it would be appropriate to set aside the award and remand the matter to the tribunal with a direction to Tribunal to give a specific finding as to whether the vehicle in question was insured.
The appeal is accordingly allowed.
